claim_01_water_en.txt.note: Baseline. A single quoted amount is the amount claimed.

claim_02_water_es.txt.note: Date rule 1: no year, so null. Amount rule 5: 'unos 800' is approximate, use 800.

claim_04_theft_en_missing_date.txt.note: No date anywhere in the text, so null.

claim_05_collision_es_relative_date.txt.note: Date rule 2: 'el martes pasado' is relative, so null.

claim_06_storm_es_amount_words.txt.note: Amount rule 2: 'dos mil quinientos euros' is 2500. Storm damage is 'other'.

claim_07_collision_en_usd.txt.note: Currency rule 2: USD stated by code. Location rule 1: 'Florida' is where the apartment is.

claim_08_theft_en_gbp.txt.note: Currency rule 2: the pound sign maps to GBP. Location rule 1: the cottage is in Devon.

claim_09_fire_es_no_currency.txt.note: Currency rule 1: no currency word, code or symbol, so null even though the text is Spanish.

claim_10_water_en_estimate_vs_final.txt.note: Amount rule 3: the final invoice (2150) wins over the first estimate (1800).

claim_11_fire_en_no_amount.txt.note: Amount rule 8: no amount. Currency rule 4: currency is null when the amount is null.

claim_12_unclear_en.txt.note: Damage type rule 2: cause is stated as unknown, so 'unclear' (not 'other').

claim_13_two_incidents_en.txt.note: Damage type rule 1: two incidents, so 'unclear'. Date rule 8: no single incident date, so null. A total is stated, so 4300.

claim_14_fire_en_email_noise.txt.note: Noise rule 2: the quoted 2,900, the 11 May date and the CLM- reference are ignored. Name comes from the signature.

claim_15_storm_en_typos.txt.note: Typos and abbreviations. Damage type rule 3: rain is knock-on damage from a storm, so 'other'. '450 eur' is EUR.

claim_16_water_en_short.txt.note: One line. Date, amount and currency are all missing.

claim_17_fire_en_witness.txt.note: People rule 1: Henrik Voss is a witness who is named first. The claimant is Olivia Brandt.

claim_18_theft_es_number_format.txt.note: Amount rule 7: in Spanish text '2.350,50' is 2350.5.

claim_19_water_en_iso_date.txt.note: Date rule 3: ISO date is kept as is. Amount rule 7: '1,250.75' in English text is 1250.75.

claim_20_collision_es_numeric_date.txt.note: Date rule 4: '07/04/2026' is read day first, so 7 April. Amount rule 7: Spanish '1.200' is 1200.

claim_21_theft_en_month_year_only.txt.note: Date rule 5: 'March 2026' has no day, so null.

claim_22_water_es_date_range.txt.note: Date rule 5: 'entre el 10 y el 12 de marzo' is a range, so null.

claim_23_fire_en_letter_date.txt.note: Date rule 6: the letter date and the signing date (2 September 2026) are not the incident date. Location rule 4: 'Dublin' in the date line is where the letter was written, so the location is null.

claim_24_fire_en_conflicting_dates.txt.note: Date rule 7: 15 June or 16 June 2026 with no way to tell which, so null.

claim_25_water_en_two_quotes.txt.note: Amount rules 1 and 3: two competing quotes for the same repair and nothing marks one as final, so null. Currency rule 4: currency is null too.

claim_26_theft_en_itemized_total.txt.note: Amount rule 1: several amounts, and a stated total (1,240), so use the total.

claim_27_water_en_parts_no_total.txt.note: Amount rule 4: two parts (520 and 380) and no stated total. Do not add them up, so null. Currency rule 4: currency is null too.

claim_28_fire_en_amount_range.txt.note: Amount rule 5: 'between EUR 2,000 and EUR 2,500' is a range, so null. Currency rule 4: currency is null too.

claim_29_collision_en_deductible.txt.note: Amount rule 6: the excess (250) and the policy limit (10,000) are not the claimed amount.

claim_30_other_en_zero_amount.txt.note: Amount rule 8: an amount explicitly stated as zero is 0.0, not null.

claim_31_fire_en_euro_symbol.txt.note: Currency rule 2: the euro sign maps to EUR.

claim_32_collision_en_dollar_symbol.txt.note: Currency rule 2: the dollar sign maps to USD. Location rule 1: the supermarket is in Miami.

claim_33_theft_es_pounds.txt.note: Currency rule 2: 'libras esterlinas' maps to GBP. Location rules 1: the trip was to London, kept as written ('Londres').

claim_34_water_en_chf.txt.note: Currency rule 3: CHF is not EUR, USD or GBP, so 'other'. Location rule 1: the chalet is in Switzerland.

claim_35_theft_en_title.txt.note: People rule 2: the title 'Mr.' is dropped from the name.

claim_36_water_en_no_policy.txt.note: People rule 3: CLM-20931 is a claim reference, not a policy number, and no policy number is stated, so null.

claim_37_fire_en_policy_spaced.txt.note: People rule 3: policy number exactly as written, with spaces instead of hyphens.

claim_38_water_en_mixed_language.txt.note: Language rule 1: the claimant's own account is English, the pasted plumber's note is Spanish. The note carries the amount (640 euros).

claim_39_fire_de_other_language.txt.note: Language rule 1: German, so 'other'. '5. Mai 2026' is 2026-05-05 and '3.200 Euro' is 3200.

claim_40_theft_en_disclaimer_address.txt.note: Noise rule 1: address, postcode, phone, disclaimer reference number and the 2027 date are not claim facts. Location rule 5: the signature address (Springfield) is not the incident location, so null.

claim_41_fire_en_knockon_water.txt.note: Damage type rule 3: the water damage is knock-on from putting out the fire, so one incident labeled 'fire'.

claim_42_water_en_city_and_country.txt.note: Location rule 2: city and country are both stated for the incident, so both are kept.

claim_43_fire_es_home_city.txt.note: Location rule 6: the fire was at 'mi casa de Valencia', so the location is Valencia. Amount rule 7: Spanish '4.300' is 4300.

claim_44_theft_en_residence_vs_incident..note: Location rule 6: the claimant lives in Madrid, but the burglary was at the holiday flat in Lyon.

claim_45_collision_en_place_only_in_quot.note: Location rule 7: Oslo appears only in the quoted reply, so the location is null. Date rule 6 also applies: 5 September is the reply date.

claim_46_water_en_neighbour_liability.tx.note: Coverage test, gap G2. The claimed amount is the neighbour's bill.

claim_47_theft_en_business_stock.txt.note: Coverage test, gap G3. Plain extraction case.

claim_48_other_en_ransomware.txt.note: Coverage test, gap G4. A cyber event is 'other'.

claim_49_other_es_power_cut.txt.note: Coverage test, gap G5, in Spanish.

claim_50_theft_en_shared_bike_room.txt.note: Coverage test, boundary A3. The basement of an apartment block is not a place.

claim_51_water_en_slow_drip_stated.txt.note: Coverage test, exclusion C2.3. The date is when the damage was found and described.

claim_52_other_es_open_window_rain.txt.note: Coverage test, exclusion C5.3, in Spanish. Storm damage is 'other'.

claim_54_water_en_frost_occupied.txt.note: Coverage test, settled counterpart of claim_34: occupancy is stated.
